items.title: 提供 grill session 的结构化 CLI 操作
items.context: 新增 planning artifact 命令用于 start/record/close/read grill 澄清过程；它只能服务 understanding/decision/checklist，不属于 verificationEvidence 或 validation evidence。
items.userSees: 用户运行 `koala grill_start` 后看到 `Grill session started` 和 sessionId；继续 `koala grill_record` 能看到 `Recorded grill question`；`koala grill_close` 后显示 `Grill session closed`。

happy.desc: PLAN 阶段创建 grill session、记录已回答问题、关闭 session 后，grill_get 返回同一个 session 且状态为 closed。

edge.desc: grill_record 在没有 active session 且未传 sessionId 时返回明确错误，不创建 verificationEvidence。
grill_close 对包含 unresolved question 的 session 显示 remainingUnknowns，而不是把它当作通过证据。

adversarial.desc: DEV/REVIEW/TEST/DONE 阶段不能通过 grill_record 伪造 verificationEvidence；grill artifact 与 checklist verificationEvidence 分离。

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke passed: start, record answered question, close, and get persisted one closed GRILL-001 session in grill.json.
Smoke passed: grill_record without an active session throws No active grill session and leaves grill/checklist evidence empty.
Smoke passed: grill_close returns remainingUnknowns for unresolved questions without treating them as evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:grill-planning-artifact-smoke && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke and process-fact contract passed: grill artifact has no verificationEvidence key, checklist/test evidence remain separate, and grill commands are non-gate L1/L0 facts.

items.title: 在 PLAN 审查中以 advisory 方式消费 grill 状态
items.context: story_review 可提示未关闭或未解决的 grill 问题，但不能新增 phase、不能阻断 lifecycle gate、不能让 transcript 成为 DONE 证据。
items.userSees: 用户运行 `koala story_review` 时，如果存在未关闭或仍有 unresolved 的 grill session，会看到 advisory 类型的 `grill_*` 提示；summary.blockerCount 仍为 0。

happy.desc: story_review 读取 grill artifact 后把开放 session 或 unresolved questions 渲染为 advisory。

edge.desc: 没有 grill artifact 的旧 story 仍可正常 story_review，不产生 blocker 或异常。

adversarial.desc: 即使 grill session unresolved，story_review 也不能把 grill issue 计为 blocker，避免新增隐式 lifecycle gate。

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke passed: story_review reads grill.json and emits grill_session_open plus grill_question_unresolved as advisory issues.
Smoke passed: story_review on a story with no grill artifact returns normally with zero grill issues and blockerCount 0.
Smoke passed: unresolved grill session leaves story_review summary.blockerCount at 0, so grill cannot become an implicit lifecycle gate.

items.title: 补充测试和文档证明 grill 不污染证据链
items.context: 覆盖 CLI 命令、artifact 持久化、PLAN advisory、process/evidence 边界；文档明确 Grill clarifies intent; evidence proves behavior。
items.userSees: 用户查看 `koala grill_get`、`koala story_review` 和项目文档时，能看到 `Grill clarifies intent; evidence proves behavior`，并且测试输出证明 grill 命令不是 gateEvidence。

happy.desc: 新增 smoke 覆盖 grill_start/record/close/get 的持久化和命令生命周期策略。

edge.desc: process fact contract 和 flow stability 检查确认 grill 命令不是 gateEvidence，不进入 validation evidence。

adversarial.desc: 文档和测试都证明不能用 grill transcript 替代 verificationEvidence 或 koala validate。

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke passed: grill_start/record/close/get persistence, registry wiring, command policy, and phase allowlist are covered.

verificationEvidence.command: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Process fact contract and flow stability smoke passed: grill commands are supported L1/L0 command facts, not gateEvidence or validation evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Grill clarifies intent; evidence proves behavior|grill\.json|gateEvidence|validation evidence" docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md docs/requirements/decisions/truth-source.md packages/main/src/tasks/grill-planning-artifact-smoke.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Docs and smoke test contain the evidence boundary phrase and explicitly state grill.json cannot replace verificationEvidence or koala validate.
